findings.title: `orchid task set <id> depends_on T002 T003` unquoted silently keeps only `T002` — the `set` arm takes `val="$3"` and never rejects leftover args, so the whitespace form the new die message advertises drops dependencies and lets a task dispatch ahead of them

the write-time gate still accepts a self-dependency or a cycle (both files exist), and a hand-edited frontmatter never passes through it at all — those ids stay permanently unsatisfiable and still render as an ordinary `waiting-deps (<id>)`

PROTOCOL.md's PLANNING step 2 still says to create a task then fill in `depends_on`, without noting the new ordering constraint that every referenced id must already exist — kernel.md documents it, the actor-facing protocol does not
